lesson.title: Antifragility Beyond Bitcoin
lesson.topic: Exploring how antifragile principles apply beyond cryptocurrency to personal growth and resilience in various aspects of life.
lesson.steelman: How can individuals adopt an antifragile mindset to enhance their personal development, mental health, and career prospects?
lesson.example: Discussing how embracing challenges in personal relationships or professional projects can lead to stronger, more resilient outcomes.

rationale: Expanding the concept of antifragility beyond its application in cryptocurrency to broader personal and professional contexts.
